CORE_08_RUNTIME.title: Live RS-485 Modbus RTU Half-Duplex Polling on Port MJ1
CORE_08_RUNTIME.driver: MJ1 CT RTU Modbus CMP v5.05 (CTRtu.dll v5.5.0.0)

test_cases.name: Bus Electrical Layer Verification
test_cases.precondition: Power OFF; line wired with 120 Ohm termination resistors at both ends
test_cases.action: Measure impedance across lines A & B; apply power and measure idle DC differential
test_cases.expected: Impedance = 60 +/- 5 Ohm; idle differential V_B_A >= +200 mV; zero ground loop

test_cases.name: DEV_LT01 Level Sensor Polling
test_cases.expected: %AI1 reads approx 8000; %R101 scales to 25.0% +/- 0.5%; %M10=0; %M11=0

test_cases.name: DEV_FT01 Flowmeter Polling
test_cases.precondition: Slave Addr 2 online; feed pump active

test_cases.name: DEV_PT01 Pressure Sensor Polling
test_cases.precondition: Slave Addr 3 online; discharge line pressurized

test_cases.name: Sensor Underflow Quality Fault Test
test_cases.expected: %M11 sets to 1 (BAD); %R101 clamps fail-safe to 0.0%

test_cases.name: Sensor Overflow Quality Fault Test
test_cases.expected: %M11 sets to 1 (BAD); %R101 clamps fail-safe to 100.0%

test_cases.name: Serial Disconnect Watchdog Trip & Pump Interlock
test_cases.precondition: System running in AUTO; pump %Q1 energized
test_cases.action: Disconnect MJ1 RJ45 cable for > 2.0 s
test_cases.expected: %M10 trips to 1 (Comm Fault); %M11 sets to 1; pump %Q1 immediately de-energizes

test_cases.name: Auto-Recovery on Reconnect
test_cases.expected: Modbus frames resume within 500 ms; %M10 and %M11 clear to 0 without PLC restart

CORE_09_HMI_WEBMI.title: Physical 3.5 inch Touchscreen & WebMI Remote Streaming Verification

test_cases.name: Touch Digitizer 4-Point Calibration
test_cases.precondition: Controller powered ON; System Menu active
test_cases.expected: Coordinate error < 2 px across all 4 quadrants

test_cases.name: Screen 1 Overview Panel Rendering
test_cases.precondition: Controller in RUN; default Screen 1 loaded
test_cases.action: Visually inspect layout and test jump navigation button
test_cases.expected: No text clipping; jump button switches display cleanly to Screen 2

test_cases.name: Screen 2 Process Animation & Level Bar
test_cases.action: Vary level 20% to 80% and observe graphic bar
test_cases.expected: Tank bar animates fill level smoothly; digital readouts match %R101

test_cases.name: High Alarm Banner Visual Indication
test_cases.expected: %M1 sets to 1; red alarm banner flashes on screen

test_cases.name: Low Alarm Banner Visual Indication
test_cases.expected: %M2 sets to 1; amber warning banner flashes on screen

test_cases.name: Alarm Acknowledge Touch Pushbutton
test_cases.expected: Flashing transitions to steady illuminated banner

test_cases.name: Screen 3 Dual-Pen Real-Time Trend
test_cases.expected: Dual pens (PV red, SP green) scroll at 100 ms sample rate

test_cases.name: WebMI Remote Browser Mirroring
test_cases.action: Open browser to http://192.168.254.128 and log in
test_cases.expected: HTML5 SVG mirror updates smoothly with latency <= 250 ms

CORE_10_SOAK.title: 24-Hour Continuous Telemetry Soak under Dynamic Hydraulic Load

test_cases.name: Continuous Execution Stability (24h)
test_cases.action: Log controller status every hour for 24 consecutive hours
test_cases.expected: Zero CPU faults, zero watchdog trips, zero task exceptions

test_cases.name: Modbus RS-485 Cumulative Packet Reliability
test_cases.action: Calculate total Modbus transactions and CRC error counts
test_cases.expected: Total transactions >= 864,000; dropped packet rate < 0.01%

test_cases.name: Dynamic Level Regulation Stability
test_cases.precondition: Feed pump %Q1 and drain valve %Q2 cycling
test_cases.action: Audit level deviation from setpoint over dynamic cycles
test_cases.expected: Level maintained within +/- 2.5% span without hunting

test_cases.name: Thermal Drift & Environmental Stability
test_cases.action: Measure sensor calibration drift at min and max ambient temp
test_cases.expected: Zero drift < 0.25% span; span drift < 0.50%

test_cases.name: Memory & System Resource Degradation Audit
test_cases.expected: Scan time stable within +/- 1 ms; zero memory leak

test_cases.name: Transient Electrical Noise Immunity
test_cases.action: Monitor serial CRC error counter during motor start inrush
test_cases.expected: Zero false communication trips or corrupted analog readings

test_cases.name: End-of-Soak Fail-Safe Trip Audit
test_cases.expected: Pump %Q1 and valve %Q2 safely transition to de-energized state
